identificationModule.briefTitle: The FLOT Regimen Conversion Therapy of Adenocarcinoma of the Stomach / Gastroesophageal
identificationModule.officialTitle: The Clinical Study of FLOT Regimen Conversion Therapy of Her-2 Negative and Single Site Metastasis Adenocarcinoma of the Stomach / Gastroesophageal

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Evaluate survival benefit of surgical treatment after FLOT regimen conversion therapy of Her-2 Negative and single site metastasis adenocarcinoma of the stomach / gastroesophageal compared with chemotherapy, use relevant biomarkers to evaluate the efficacy of chemotherapy and seek for patients with Her-2 negative and metastatic adenocarcinoma of the stomach / gastroesophageal surviving benefit from surgical treatment after the FLOT regimen conversion therapy.
